name: ctxbudgeter
summary: Model-agnostic context intelligence for AI agents: compile, audit and govern LLM context before every call, and let agents manage their own context safely — a governed context API (compact, pin, archive, recall, rollback), graduated autonomy, a portable context-management skill, behavioural policy learning, the CTXBench benchmark, training-data export and an MCP server. Token budgets, PII/secret scanning, Context Bill of Materials, Context MRI. Framework-agnostic. Local-first. Deterministic.
